explanation: The revealed solution confirms f'(x)=-(x-3)^2/x^4. It is negative on both sides of x=3, so the derivative does not change sign there. Thus x=3 is neither a minimum nor a maximum, and the function has no local extrema.

answers.correct_value: The function $f(x)$ has no local extrema
